==Usage==
To add a magazine to [[:Category:Magazine stubs]], type <code><nowiki>{{Magazine-stub}}</nowiki></code>.

To add a magazine issue to [[:Category:Magazine issue stubs]], type <code><nowiki>{{Magazine-stub|issue}}</nowiki></code>.

To add a magazine article to [[:Category:Magazine article stubs]], type <code><nowiki>{{Magazine-stub|article}}</nowiki></code>.
